text.p: Average yields at auctions of three-month treasury bills fell, yields on six-month and nine-month bills were unchanged and 12-month yields rose from the previous sales in Ukraine, a central bank statement said on Thursday.

Three-month bills slipped to 24.43 from 24.47 percent, six-month bills stayed at 31.27 percent, nine-month bills remained at 34.86 percent, and 12-month bills firmed to 39.89 percent from 39.87 percent.
The results of Thursday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 3.50 million UAH 5.00 million UAH
Amount sold 3.50 million UAH 0.46 million UAH
Actual amount raised 3.29 million UAH 0.44 million UAH
The central bank sold 35,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 20.00 million UAH 20.00 million UAH
Amount sold 17.23 million UAH 6.34 million UAH
Actual amount raised 14.90 million UAH 5.49 million UAH
The central bank sold 172,263 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 18.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Actual amount raised 4.11 million UAH 76,940 UAH
The central bank sold 51,811 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is April 18.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 20.00 million UAH 22.00 million UAH
Amount sold 10.15 million UAH 3.99 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.26 million UAH 2.85 million UAH
The central bank sold 101,465 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 18.
